title: iynk component definition, schema 1 (minor 1.1)
description: One file per component version. Specified in docs/MASTER_PLAN/04_ARCHITECTURE/COMPONENT_SCHEMA.md. JSON Schema cannot check cross-references (pin ids, rating keys, source ids); the registry loader does that, see section 6 of the spec.

internal_nets.description: Named internal rails that layers read or drive and that are not pins, for example a regulator output.

allOf.description: Only core parts may ship executable figure pages (HTML with script). Local and imported parts bring SVG or PNG art, which the loader sanitises, or use the generic fallback.

text.description: Display text. Shipped parts give i18n_key plus the English fallback; custom parts give inline translations only.

unit.description: Files store base units only. No prefixed units (write 0.02 A, never 20 mA). The UI picks the prefix.

quantity.description: A number with a unit: either one value, or a min/typ/max triple with at least one member.

loc.description: Page, table, figure or line, for example 'p.5 table 7' or 'figures/parts/led.js:13'.

reliability.description: primary: the maker's own document read in full. secondary: a mirror, a reseller or a third party. unverified: from memory or a snippet.

manufacturer.description: The maker, or 'generic' when no single maker exists.

refdes_prefix.description: Reference designator prefix for this part: R, C, D, U, Q, J, SW, BT, M (motor). The editor numbers parts R1, R2... Absent: the editor derives a prefix from category (Studio O-S3 table).

generic.description: True when there is no maker datasheet for this exact part (a 5 mm LED, a red L298N board). A non-generic part must cite a datasheet-class source.

legacy_ids.description: Ids used by the existing figure and interpreter code, so old projects and lessons keep resolving.

designator.description: The number or label on the real part: '1', 'H1.1', '+12V'.

class.description: The coarse role the project document and the netlist use.

position.description: Millimetres in the part frame (origin bottom-left, +x right, +y up, +z up from the board), resolution 0.01 mm.

rating.description: Rating key holding the resistance. The loader stamps it as a resistor to the rail or to ground.

unless_parameter.description: A boolean build-option parameter; the pull exists only while it is true.

pins.description: Pin ids in the order along the connector.

body.description: mm: width along x, depth along y, height above the board or breadboard along z.

accuracy.description: Stated accuracy of the positions in mm; 0.3 for values measured from a photo.

stated.description: Manufacturer slot: a number a maker printed. A source is required.

assumed.description: Simulation slot: a number iynk chose. A rationale and a confidence are required, so nobody mistakes it for a datasheet figure.

derived_from.description: Rating slots this was computed or fitted from.

measured.description: Bench slot: a number measured on real hardware by a person. Method, sample size and date are required. The UI says 'bench-measured', never 'validated'.

rating.description: One named limit or characteristic with three separate slots. used_by_model names the slot the simulation reads, so a changed assumption is a visible edit.

used_by_model.description: 'none' means the value is shown to the person but no model reads it.

primary.description: True when the model output depends strongly on this number. The fidelity registry T2 rule requires every primary parameter to have a datasheet, fit or measurement source.

pins.description: Signal name to pin id, for example {sda: 'SDA', scl: 'SCL'}.

params.description: Kind-specific values: for i2c, address and alt_address.

speed_max.description: Rating key whose value is the highest clock or baud rate.

status.description: Whether iynk's runtimes implement this protocol for this part. Anything else must not run silently (R-FID-3).

voltage.description: Rating key for the operating or recommended range.

current.description: Rating key for the consumption or limit.

condition.description: When this input is used, for example 'jumper JP5 fitted'.

parameter.description: A value the person sets on a placed instance: a colour, a jumper, a resistor value, an I2C address variant.

kind.description: variant: which product. build-option: a jumper or solder bridge. setting: a dial. environment: an outside condition.

affects.description: Pin ids, layer ids or rating keys that change with this parameter.

physicalChannel.description: A non-electrical quantity that enters or leaves the part: acceleration into an IMU, light onto an LED's output, torque out of a motor.

world_channel.description: The name of the channel in the world or environment model that drives or reads it.

elementKind.description: Built-in solver elements. The first group exists today (figures/engine/bench-solve.js:88-113). The second group is planned and needs the SIM phase; a part that names one loads as 'not modelled yet' on a solver that lacks it.

paramValue.description: A model parameter. from_rating or by_parameter point at ratings; the model then reads the slot that rating names in used_by_model. A literal value must carry a rationale.

pick.description: Which member of a min/typ/max triple.

by_parameter.description: Pick the rating by the value of an instance parameter, for example the LED colour.

terminals.description: Solver terminal name to pin id.

component.description: Another component, pinned to an exact version.

ref.description: A behaviour iynk ships in code, for example device:mpu6050@1. The major number is the behaviour contract.

implementation.description: Where the code is today, for the migration table. Informational.

output_drive.description: Rating key for the output voltage and current the table drives with.

reads.description: Pin ids, physical input ids, parameter ids.

target.description: A pin id, a layer id, or 'part'.

for.description: How long the condition must hold, a duration in s.

cause_id.description: The id of the cause in the shared diagnosis record (D-010).

latched.description: True until the part is replaced or the person resets it.

derivation.description: How the threshold was obtained: formula, source, and what was judged.

implemented_as.description: threshold: the model evaluates 'when'. scripted: the behaviour exists but is driven by a timer or a flag, not the quantities in 'when'. not-implemented: documented only.

legacy_id.description: The fault string the figure code uses today, for example 'cold:J2'.

tier.description: Asserted tier, numbered as SIMULATION_ARCHITECTURE section 4.1: T0 illustration, T1 teaching model, T2 calculated model, T3 runs firmware. The registry CI rules (section 16.3 there) fail a tier the evidence does not support.

state.description: to-write: the descriptor names a test the conversion still has to add. The PARTS gate fails any part with a to-write test.

mocked.description: Behaviour that is faked on purpose and labelled so, for example a fixed Wi-Fi scan list. Separate from not_modelled.

install.description: The name in the language's library manager.

iynk_support.description: What iynk's own runtimes do with this library today. 'unsupported' must produce a named diagnostic, never silence.

works_with.description: Board or part ids it is known to be used with.

legs.description: Pin ids in the figure's leg order (B.part legs).

fallback.description: Drawn from pins, dimensions and this block alone, so a part without art still places, wires and runs. CI fails a descriptor without it.

license.description: Required (R-138). Use LicenseRef-iynk-pending while D-017 is open.

third_party_content.description: True if text, numbers or art were copied from a third-party site and still need the D-017 check.

mechanics.description: Physical data the robot and drone engines read (minor 1.1, optional). Names and units follow ROBOTICS_ARCHITECTURE 6.1 and DRONE_ARCHITECTURE 6.1: the unit is in the field name and is a base unit (kg m^2, N m, rad, s, A, V, ohm, H), except kv_rpm_per_v and mm/g/mAh/deg, which are the hobby units named in the field. Every sub-block may carry `source`, a sourceRef to a sources[] entry; the three-slot rating rule applies to published numbers (COMPONENT_SCHEMA 4.6).

motor.description: Brushed DC (kv and ke are alternatives, give one) or brushless (kv_rpm_per_v; ke = 60 / (2 pi kv) is derived).

l_henry.description: 0 or absent selects the algebraic armature (ROBOTICS 6.1).

ke_vs_per_rad.description: Back-EMF constant; kt equals it in SI and is stored once.

speed_rad_per_s.description: Derived (pi/3 / speed_s_per_60deg); give it only to override.

mu.description: Friction coefficient against a reference surface.

prop.description: Propeller. T = ct0 rho n^2 D^4 and P = cp0 rho n^3 D^5 with n in rev/s (DRONE_ARCHITECTURE 6.1).

ocv_table.description: Open-circuit volts per cell, from full to empty, evenly spaced in state of charge.

sensor.description: Range and beam data for sensors that query the physics world (ROBOTICS_ARCHITECTURE 8). Units in the field names.
